ns2:section.sectionText: This section is reserved for UIUC undergraduate students (others interested in this course may enroll in ENG 451 SW2). ENG 451 SW1 is an online course worth two hours of credit and counts toward the Other Social Sciences/Humanities requirement for engineering students. Online and Continuing Education assessments of $586 per credit hour apply. This course is restricted to students who have a career-related internship or co-op during the Summer 2012 term. If you do not meet this requirement you will be disqualified from the course. Please contact Sarah Zehr at szehr@illinois.edu or 217-333-1960 with questions about this policy. If ENG 451 SW1 is your only Summer 2012 course, a full refund is only available by cancelling your registration on or before May 28, 2012. If you are enrolled in other Summer 2012 courses in addition to ENG 451 SW1, you have until June 4, 2012 to drop ENG 451 SW1 with a full refund if you remain in at least one other Summer 2012 course.
